topic: Recalculating session data for specific company
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on data recalculation and monitoring for a specific company (7600) related to session counts. Initially, a frequency formula was requested for use in dashboards.

Multiple requests were made to re-process historical session data for the specified facility/company:
1.  Transferring recalculated sessions from September into the main session table.
2.  Extracting data for the period 08-10.2023 into a separate table for monitoring purposes.
3.  Recalculating sessions for the entire period from October 2023 to the present, following previous work done in September 2023.

The discussion identified that changes in calibration (especially for Rail starting April 8, 2024) and potential errors in date ranges were contributing factors to observed drops in session counts. It was determined that a recalculation of sessions using the new calibration rules for the specified company would be performed, with data segmented into three-month chunks due to disk space limitations.
decisions: A frequency formula will be implemented on staging (not beta) for dashboard use.
Recalculated session data for the specified facility/company must be transferred and reprocessed using updated calibration rules.
Data extraction for monitoring purposes is required for 08-10.2023, separate from the main tables.
action_items: Implement frequency formula on staging environment.
Perform session recalculation for the specified company (7600) covering October 2023 to present, using three-month segments.
Transfer recalculated sessions from September into the main session table.
